binding.unit: each reviewed_project object embedded in projects
binding.sha256_encoding: SHA-256 of json.dumps(reviewed_project, sort_keys=True, separators=(',', ':'), ensure_ascii=False).encode('utf-8'), without a trailing newline
binding.meaning: Per-project review snapshots and immutable source/license/setup pins remain independently checkable as the combined workflow manifest evolves.

review_method: Resolve each public repository default branch to a full immutable Git commit and retain primary metadata plus a complete untruncated Git tree.
Fetch only explicitly selected bounded regular UTF-8 text at that commit. Verify byte length, SHA-256 and Git blob SHA-1 against the frozen tree.

Parse selected Python with ast.parse and inspect the real main guard and operational calls, imports and declared workflow requirements, without importing the upstream modules or evaluating configuration.
Verify pinned first-party license documents and explicit source notices; separately retain author/setup identity anchors, external model/dataset constraints and vendored license declarations.
Preserve per-workflow Python/hardware/weight/data/service declarations as data, with literal pinned evidence for specific robot names. Generic workflows receive no robot-name compatibility inference.
Construct source-only records offline and verify an identical second build and the generated source index.

preintegration_deduplication.scope: Historical deduplication against the catalog read during source review; this is not a hash or count assertion about the later merged catalog.
